newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- EOE trade dulled by Fed meeting.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- EOE trade dulled by Fed meeting.

text.p: Trade on the European Options Exchange (EOE) on Tuesday reflected the cautious mood seen in other markets ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting but dealers said despite the low volume the mood was cautiously optimistic.
Some market makers cited a strategy of buying October calls on the EOE index with strikes at 570 points and selling the 580s as typical of the mildly bullish market sentiment.
Dealers said the EOE contract had taken over 20 percent of total business, with the number of calls and puts roughly equal.
Activity in Akzo matched interest in the underlying sparked by drug trials of Remeron. -- Amsterdam newsdesk +31 20 504 5000
